failure_summary.description: n_obs alignment is a hard constraint but failure modes (off-by-one, reordered indices, missing samples) are not enumerated

edits.content:
## Alignment failure modes

The `agg_features.n_obs == rna.n_obs` check is necessary but not
sufficient. Also verify:

- `agg_features.obs.index.equals(rna.obs.index)` — ordering must match,
  not just count
- No duplicate sample_ids on either side
- Censored / missing samples are dropped consistently on BOTH sides
- For paired multiomics, also confirm `rna.var` does not contain features
  that should have been filtered (mito / ribo)

If any fail, abort and surface which sample_ids are mismatched.
